in_hebrew.name: Vachel
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Vachel הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'agelas', meaning 'kid' or 'lamb', and 'vachas', meaning 'herdsman' or 'shepherd'. In Christian tradition, the name Vachel symbolizes the love and care of God as a shepherd to his flock.
